attchmntText: Rollatainers Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of Un-Audited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended on September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Rollatainers Limited submitted newspaper cuttings to BSE Limited and NSE Limited regarding the publication of un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended on September 30, 2026. The results were published in Financial Express and Jansatta on November 15, 2026. The company also uploaded the publications to its website at www.rollatainers.in. This filing is pursuant to Regulation 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The submission was made by Aditi Jain, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Rollatainers Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of the Postal Ballot Notice.
voiceSummary: Rollatainers Limited, scrip code 502448, symbol ROLLT, has published a notice in the Financial Express and Jansatta on 14th November 2026. This publication confirms the dispatch of the Postal Ballot Notice on Friday, November 13, 2026. The announcement is made pursuant to Regulation 30 and 47 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company secretary, Aditi Jain, has submitted this intimation to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange Limited. The newspaper advertisements are also available on the company website at www.rollatainers.in. The specific resolutions subject to the postal ballot are not detailed in this text. Shareholder approval for the matters in the notice is pending.

attchmntText: Rollatainers Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Rollatainers Limited reported a loss of 22.58 lakh rupees for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and 38.07 lakh rupees for the half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board approved these unaudited financial results on November 13, 2026. The company received in-principle approvals from BSE and NSE for issuing 35,87,44,394 convertible warrants at Rs. 2.23 per warrant, aggregating to approximately Rs. 80 crore. The company has already allotted 13,45,29,149 warrants on October 26, 2026, and 22,42,15,245 warrants on October 30, 2026. The Board also approved the proposed acquisition of 62.14% stake in Satelite Forging Private Limited for Rs. 51.55 crore, subject to shareholder approval. Proposals to change the company name to Amaxis Global Limited, shift the registered office to Manesar, and alter the main object clause are pending shareholder and statutory approvals. An Enforcement Directorate attachment order remains sub-judice but does not affect business operations.

attchmntText: Rollatainers Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of Postal Ballot
voiceSummary: Rollatainers Limited has issued a notice for a postal ballot to seek shareholder approval for four special resolutions. The proposals include altering the object clause of the Memorandum of Association, changing the company name to Amaxis Global Limited, shifting the registered office within Haryana, and approving a material related party transaction to acquire equity shares of Pluto Biz Developers Private Limited from Newtime Infrastructure Limited. The e-voting period commences at 9:00 a.m. on 14th November 2026 and ends at 5:00 p.m. on 13th December 2026. Mr. Sachin Khurana has been appointed as the scrutinizer. The results are expected to be announced by 15th December 2026. The resolutions are pending vote and subject to shareholder approval.
